T: That'll do, pig. No pork on this menu.
D: A piglet raised by sheepdogs learns to herd sheep.
P: Serve dessert when Farmer Hoggett says that'll do, pig.
S: Egg and lettuce sandwiches on soft white bread, eggs boiled 10 minutes, mashed with mayo, chives and white pepper.
Ewe's milk cheese (pecorino), sheep's feta and fresh ricotta on a board with honey, figs and crackers.
Ferdinand the duck, sneaking round the vegie patch

Crisp baby carrots, radish, cucumber, snow peas and cherry tomatoes with a bright green goddess dip of herbs, sour cream and lemon. Blitz 150g sour cream, 80g mayonnaise, a handful each of parsley, basil and chives, 1 spring onion, the juice of half a lemon and salt until smooth and green. Chill 30 minutes. Trim 1 bunch baby carrots and 1 bunch radishes, cut 1 Lebanese cucumber into sticks and top 150g snow peas. Arrange around the dip with 250g cherry tomatoes.
M: Farmhouse leek, mushroom and cheddar pie
no pigs or ducks were harmed in this pie

Leek, mushroom and potato in a creamy cheddar and thyme sauce under a golden puff pastry lid, with buttered peas on the side. Boil 500g diced potato for 8 minutes and drain. Cook 2 sliced leeks and 300g sliced mushrooms in 40g butter for 10 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp flour, then 400ml milk and simmer 3 minutes. Add 150g grated cheddar, thyme, the potato, salt and pepper. Pour into a pie dish, cover with 2 sheets puff pastry, brush with egg and bake at 200C for 30 minutes. Serve with 400g buttered peas.
the sheep Babe herds, but with beef in the pie
Beef mince browned hard, onion and carrot softened, tomato paste, Worcestershire and stock, simmered 40 minutes, topped with buttery mash, forked and baked at 200C for 25 minutes until golden.
W: Apples stewed with sugar and cinnamon, crumble of flour, butter, oats and brown sugar, baked at 180C for 35 minutes. Custard.
K: Cold full cream milk blended thick with vanilla ice cream, malt powder and a drizzle of honey, topped with whipped cream in tall glasses. Put 600ml cold full cream milk, 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tbsp honey in a blender. Blend 30 seconds until thick and frothy. Pour into 4 chilled tall glasses. Whip 150ml thickened cream to soft peaks and spoon on top, then dust with a pinch of malt powder.

s.how: Boil 6 eggs for 10 minutes, cool and peel. Mash with 3 tbsp mayo, chives and white pepper. Spread on 8 slices soft white bread with shredded iceberg, close and cut into triangles.
Take 150g pecorino, 150g sheep's feta and 200g fresh ricotta out of the fridge an hour ahead. Arrange on a board with 4 halved figs, a drizzle of honey and crackers.

m.note: the sheep Babe herds, but with beef in the pie
m.how: Brown 750g beef mince hard. Add a diced onion and 2 carrots, then 2 tbsp tomato paste, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and 250ml stock and simmer 40 minutes. Top with 1kg potatoes mashed with 60g butter, fork the top and bake at 200C for 25 minutes.

w.how: Stew 6 sliced apples with 60g sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon for 10 minutes and tip into a dish. Rub 100g butter into 100g flour, then stir in 60g oats and 80g brown sugar. Scatter over and bake at 180C for 35 minutes. Serve with custard.

d.how: Put 600ml cold full cream milk, 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 4 tbsp malted milk powder and 1 tbsp honey in a blender. Blend 30 seconds until thick and frothy. Pour into 4 chilled tall glasses. Whip 150ml thickened cream to soft peaks and spoon on top, then dust with a pinch of malt powder.
